$comment: Local CTRLpanel context sync config example; copy to tools/context-projects.json. Add a project with: node tools/ctrlpanel-file-sync.mjs --add --name ... --root ... --folder ... --match ...  'files' are relative paths or single-segment * globs (max 3 levels); omit 'files' to use the default context list. 'project' is the CTRLpanel project name to attach notes to (exact, case-insensitive). 'key' must never change once synced.
